prompts.wheat:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready transparent pixel-art crop sprite sheet for orbitFarm, imported into Figma.
Create ONE square PNG sprite sheet containing EXACTLY FOUR isolated WHEAT sprites in a precise 2 by 2 grid of equal square cells, no grid lines. Crop is bread wheat, not barley.
Frame order: upper left a tiny green seedling with three thin grass leaves; upper right a small leafy green tillering clump; lower left a harvest-ready compact clump of three golden wheat stems with short plump grain ears and short awns; lower right an inventory item of three harvested golden wheat ears tied together simply.
Every cell contains only ONE sprite centered horizontally, with the same ground anchor at 84 percent of its cell height. Keep 15 percent empty padding all around. No sprite crosses a cell boundary.
Style: original cozy 16-bit farming-game PIXEL ART. Each sprite is deliberately drawn on a 32 by 32 logical pixel grid, then uniformly enlarged with nearest-neighbor so that individual square pixels are visible and hard edged. Very simple readable silhouettes, one logical pixel dark-green outline, only 2 or 3 flat shades per material, maximum 12 colors. Slightly elevated orthographic front view used in top-down farming games. This must look like a usable tiny game sprite, not a detailed illustration, vector, painting or voxel render.
Palette: outline #203D32; foliage #286B45 #4F8C4C #8DBB62 #DDEDC5; wheat #F4C95D #D69B43 #A46D37; highlight #FFF8E8. No soil tile, no roots, no pots, no ground oval, no cast shadow, no scenery, no faces, no words, no letters, no labels, no decorative border, no watermark.
Background is genuine transparent alpha, not a painted checkerboard. All empty space completely transparent. Four sprites only.
